authorization_source: explicit user approval in the active task

train_validation_hashes.derivation: SHA-256 of newline-delimited canonical JSON records from the generated split manifest, filtered by split and retained in manifest order; this is supplementary to semantic_split_hash.

allowed_workloads: Phase 6 development canonical Evo2 scoring on TRAIN and VALIDATION only
Phase 6 resumable batching and persistent score caching
Phase 6 CADD and PhyloP development comparator integration without forced missing values
Phase 7 frozen Nucleotide Transformer embedding extraction on TRAIN and VALIDATION only
Phase 7 frozen Caduceus embedding extraction on TRAIN and VALIDATION only
Phase 7 Evo2 embedding pilot or extraction only if technically supported and within this cap
Small parity or sanity jobs required to validate the approved workloads
Local CPU-only Phases 8, 9, 11, 12, and 13 using development artifacts and validation-only selection
excluded_workloads: Final evaluation using the 946 LOCKED_TEST labels
Joining LOCKED_TEST predictions with outcome labels
LOCKED_TEST AUROC, AUPRC, MCC, threshold selection, or any other final metric
HPO or ensemble selection using LOCKED_TEST information
Calibration or abstention selection using LOCKED_TEST information
Full Evo2 fine-tuning, PEFT or fine-tuning sweeps, and foundation-model HPO
Inference over the approximately 1.4 million record t0 VUS population
stop_conditions: Stop before cumulative additional Modal metered compute reaches 5.00 USD.
Stop immediately if projected additional spend exceeds 5.00 USD.
Stop if the checkpoint or scientific contract changes unexpectedly.
Stop if cache provenance cannot be verified.
Stop if any split hash differs from this artifact.
Do not silently widen scope or budget.

execution_contract.resume_policy: idempotent run IDs, persistent cache, skip verified completed variants
execution_contract.alpha_missense: subset-only if a reproducibly obtained public prediction asset is available
execution_contract.random_seed_policy: record every seed in each registered artifact
